market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by subdued volume and consolidation across metals, FX, and crypto following earlier intraday selloffs. XAUUSD, XAGUSD, EURUSD, and BTCUSD are consolidating below their respective daily VWAPs and Value Area boundaries on low RVOL, warranting defensive HOLD stances. In contrast, US100 exhibits strong structural resilience, holding firmly above VWAP, EMA50, and VAH, with a clean rejection of S/R support at 28265.71 offering an actionable BUY scalp opportunity toward session highs.

signals.rationale: Price at 3873.30 is inside the Value Area (VAL 3852.35 to VAH 3973.69) and trading below POC at 3880.46. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD reads -5.79 (BEARISH) with a negative slope (-0.70), agreeing with the macro downtrend. Price is well below downward-sloping VWAP (3926.16) and structural EMA50 (3902.79). Candles are consolidating mid-channel between the EMA20 baseline (3882.78) and lower ATR band (3867.39). Volume is unconfirmed with RVOL at 1.016 showing no yellow volume spikes. Price is ranging above Session Low support at 3852.35 without directional momentum or clean retest, dictating a HOLD.

Price at 1.10552 is below VAL (1.10605) and well below POC (1.10942). During NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD is -1430 (NEUTRAL) with positive slope (+1551.34), indicating delta divergence against the weak price structure. Price remains below both VWAP (1.10754) and EMA50 (1.10677). Candles are compressed mid-channel between EMA20 (1.10575) and lower ATR band (1.10468). RVOL is very low at 0.384 with no yellow breakout spikes. Price is caught in a tight drift above Session Low support at 1.10457 and below S/R resistance at 1.10662, warranting a HOLD.

Price at 1.32369 is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32210 to VAH 1.32665) and hovering directly at POC (1.32360). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD prints -158 (NEUTRAL) with a mildly negative slope (-172.32). Price is below VWAP (1.32513) and EMA50 (1.32461), pinned directly onto the EMA20 baseline (1.32363). Volatility is compressed mid-channel between the ATR bands (1.32236 to 1.32489). RVOL is subdued at 0.445 without volume confirmation. With price pinned to fair-value POC above Session Low (1.32210) and below S/R (1.32500), setup indicates mean-reverting chop and warrants a HOLD.

Price at 28322.85 is above VAH (28282.66) and above POC (28122.95). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD is +2.32 (NEUTRAL) with an accelerating positive slope (+1.22), reflecting buyer absorption. Price remains firmly above VWAP (28195.39) and structural EMA50 (28254.58), while reclaiming the EMA20 baseline (28297.27). ATR channel is expanding with price pushing toward upper ATR band (28455.31). RVOL is 0.880, which is normal given Dukascopy index CFD tick volume characteristics where yellow spikes are rare. S/R support at 28265.71 held with a clear rejection wick on the pullback, confirming an intraday higher low and offering a long continuation scalp toward Session High (28550.97).

Price at 49.968 is below VAL (50.316) and below POC (51.460). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD reads -244 (BEARISH) with slope +9.53, showing slight delta divergence. Price is positioned well below downward-sloping VWAP (50.934) and EMA50 (50.433), struggling below EMA20 (50.121). ATR channel is contracting with price lingering mid-channel above lower ATR band (49.798). RVOL is neutral at 1.018 with no yellow breakout confirmation bars. Price is drifting sideways above Session Low support at 49.688 and below S/R resistance at 50.711 without catalyst, making HOLD the appropriate choice.

Price at 71376.60 is below VAL (71738.62) and below POC (73501.60). During NEW_YORK_SESSION, CVD is -0.08 (BEARISH) with slope -0.01, aligned with the broader decline. Price is trading substantially below descending VWAP (72638.55) and EMA50 (72146.92), as well as below EMA20 (71643.29). ATR band position is mid-channel above lower ATR band (71104.17). RVOL sits at 0.834 with 31 bars since the last yellow volume spike, indicating fading sell interest but no buying conviction. Price is consolidating narrowly above Session Low at 71141.00 and below VAL, supporting a disciplined HOLD.
